# Repository Instructions

- The Orchestrator is the only entry point for the SDLC workflow.
- Follow PLAN, ASK, IMPLEMENT.
- Use repository artifacts for communication.
- Never fabricate requirements, test results, source status, or secrets.
- Never commit, push, merge, or create a Pull Request without explicit authorization.
- Preserve approved requirements and architecture.
- Reuse existing conventions and keep provider integrations optional.
